description:
The main character, Endou Mamoru, is a very talented goalkeeper and the grandson of one of the strongest goalkeepers in Japan, who died before he was born. Even though his skills are incredible his school lacks a real soccer club as the 6 other members don't appear very interested even in training. But as soon as a mysterious forward called Gouenji moves to Endou's town, the young goalkeeper sets out to find and recruit members for his soccer team.

(Source: Wikipedia)

node.description:
This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. 

Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.
Fubuki Shirou is the captain of Hakuren Junior High School's Soccer club in Hokkaido. He is both an excellent defender as well as the team's ace striker. He joins the Raimon Eleven from episode 33.

Endou Mamoru is the captain of Raimon jr. High's Soccer team. He starts out as a goalie but also plays as libero later on. He is the type of person who never gives up and his teammates benefit from his mental strength and encouragement. Mamoru always thinks of others before himself. He also shows great admiration toward his grandfather [Daisuke](https://anilist.co/character/31778/), which was also one of the greatest goalkeepers around when he was alive.

He is the ace striker and voice of the reason of the team. His sister, [Yuka](https://anilist.co/character/36629/Gouenji-Yuuka) is in a coma because of [Kageyama](https://anilist.co/character/32156/Kageyama-Reiji)'s interference to stop him from play against Teikoku Academy. He keeps an amulet made by his sister, and makes a promise to her to stop playing soccer, but when he realizes his passion for the game, he changes that promise to become the champion of the Football Frontier. 

(Source: Wikipedia)

He wears goggles and a red cape. Originally from Teikoku. The reason why he plays for Teikoku is for his sister, Haruna Otonashi. He was forced to win 3 constructive soccer championships in order to be with her again, so he decided not to contact her for 6 years, leading Otonashi to believe she gets in his way. After seeing Kageyama's wrongdoings, he and the rest of Teikoku quit. Eventually, Kidou joins Endo's team, changing his cape to blue but changes it back to red in the FFI arc.
Hiroto was the captain of Genesis, the supreme team of Aliea Academy. Later on he joins Inazuma Japan in FFI.

__Teams__: Zeus, ~!Raimon (Aliea Gakuen arc), Fire Dragon, Kidokawa Seishuun (Coach, GO series)!~

He is a midfielder and the captain of Zeus.

Originally a member of the track club team, Kazemaru is convinced by Endo of becoming a player of the soccer team, because the team needed 4 more players for their match against Teikoku; if Endo couldn't get them the soccer club would be closed. Kazemaru is finally convinced by the promise of fighting a lot of stronger players, altogether with Endo fighting spirit.

She is the daughter of the chairman of the school and is the student body council president. She becomes a manager because of Endo's passion for soccer. She is shown to have a romantic interest in Endo and strongly believes that he is the best goalkeeper around.

Natsumi's personality is like she likes to help out, but does not like to get her hands dirty. At first, she seems very much against the Raimon soccer club and is dead-set on disbanding it, often setting challenges for them to overcome with the threat of being shut down if they fail. After a few matches, Natsumi sees major potential in their team and becomes the third manager after Aki and Haruna.  She follows the team in the Inazuma Caravan in the Aliea Academy arc, helping out, and calling her dad to assist the team with help when needed. She is one of the few members of the team who seemed fine with Coach Hitomiko, even asking her to stay as Coach when she was about to leave, also requesting that she would bring Gouenji back to the team, only to find out Coach Hitomiko would not allow that just yet.  

~!In the 18th episode of Inazuma Eleven Go it is discovered that she married Endou.!~

(Source: Wikipedia)

A very sarcastic player whose technique and game strategizing abilities rival those of Kidou Yuuto's. His first major appearance in the anime is in episode 37 as a member of True Teikoku Academy.  His hissatsu techniques are [Season three] Killer Fields (with Kidou) and Emperor Penguin No. 3 (with Kidou and Sakuma).

Jousuke Tsunami is a surfer who lived in the South Seas in Japan, specifically Okinawa. He is completely passionate about the sea.  When he meets the team Inazuma Eleven discover the wonders of football, and he ends up being a player whose team is later defeated by them. After some confusion with the Aliea Academy, Tsunami officially joins the Inazuma Caravan.  His special techniques are: [Season two] Tsunami Boost and the Perfect Tower (with Touko and Kogure) [Season three] The Typhoon and The Tube.

Also known as Reize (in Aliea Academy arc), Midorikawa is the former captain of Aliea Academy's send rank team. After his defeat by [Endou](https://anilist.co/character/16412/Endou-Mamoru) and his team, he later joins up with them for the FFI International though he was unceremoniously left out after their Asian Prelims' final against Fire Dragon.

His hissatsu techniques include: [Season two] Astro Break and Universe Shot [Season three] Lightening Accel

One of the members of the original Teikoku team and a close friend of Kidou.   After Kidou leaves Teikoku and joins Raimon's team, he and Genda become part of Shin Teikoku with Fudou as the new captain.

Teikoku's goalkeeper, known as the "King Of Goalkeepers" (KOG) in the game. He was first in Teikoku Acdemy but in the second season, he got corrupted and joined True Teikoku Acdemy. Later, he was the goalkeeper of Neo Japan.  Hiss hissatsu are: [Season one] Power Shield, Full Power Shield [Season two] Beast Fang [Season three] Drill Smasher V2 and True Infinite Wall

Fubuki Shirou's younger brother who died in a snow sliding. His personality grew on Shirou's body and he can alternate between both, being an ace striker or a great defender. His hissatsu technique is Eternal Blizzard.
Aki and Domon's childhood friend back when they were in America together. Ichinose has the dream of turning America into a soccer nation. In the FFI arc, he joins the American team The Unicorn.

name.native: フィディオ・アルデナ

node.description: The (stand-in) captain for Italy's national team, Orpheus, during the Football Frontier International. Considered one of the best forwards in all of Europe, his team was touted to be the favourites to lift the cup.  His hissatsu are: [Season three] Odin Sword and Odin Sword Remastered

She is one of the mid-fielders of the Genesis and second-in command. Later on, she with the rest of Sun Garde orphans is seen playing their own soccer. Her hissatsu are: [Season two] Supernova (with [Wheeze](https://anilist.co/character/36812/Yuu-Izuno) and [Hiroto](https://anilist.co/character/31943/Kiyama-Hiroto)) and Space Penguins (with Hiroto and Wheeze)

In the alternate timeline of Inazuma Eleven Ares no Tenbin, she is a midfielder for Eisei Gakuen.

__Nationality:__ Japanese  

One of the top players from Alien Academy, Diamond Dust's captain and striker. 

Usually, he's calm and arrogant, always confident about his own skills. Suzuno is a smart and talented soccer player.

Originally from the school paper, after seeing Raimon play against Teikoku, she became a big fan and decided to be a manager. She is the sister of Yuuto Kidou, however, has not had any contact with him for 6 years.

__Nationality:__ Japanese

A rebellious and fearless player from Alien Academy, one of the top 3. Endo and others mistake him for Goenji, when they visited Okinawa, because of  _Fire Striker_ nickname. Nagumo challenged Endo's team for one match. He easily scored goals and proved his outstanding skills.
The team manager. She used to play soccer with her childhood friends Ichinose and Domon, but stops after experiencing a horrible trauma. She has a crush on Endo Mamoru.

Tobitaka is a slick punk from Raimon Town who leads a street gang and often gets into fights. He made a name for himself with his powerful kick and is discovered by Hibiki in the woods in the midst of another rumble with a rival gang. Hibiki urges Tobitaka to make "better use of that kick" and begins to teach him how to play Soccer in secret. Tobitaka gets a shot at joining the country's national team, Inazuma Japan and manages to get a spot for himself on the team. Slowly but surely, he develops his skills and even becomes a role model of sorts to the young Toramaru. He's never seen without his trademark hair-comb. His special technique is the Shinkuuma and later evolves into Shinkuuma V2 .  (Source: Wikipedia)
Captain of Cotarl's national team, Little Gigant, in the Football Frontier International. His main position is goalkeeper.

Toramaru is an Elementary School student and the best soccer player in his district. Because of his young age, he is exempt from joining the Football Frontier and playing professionally, but later is brought in by Coach Hibiki to join Japan's national team, "Inazuma Japan". During the day, Toramaru helps part time at his sickly mother's restaurant, making deliveries all day long that cut into his Soccer practice. When he's chosen to represent Japan for the Football Frontier International, he becomes a valuable player for Endou and his friends. He especially looks up to Gouenji, and eventually Tobitaka as role models.  His hissatsu techniques: [Season three]  Tiger Drive, Tiger Storm (with Gouenji), Gladius Arch, RC Shoot, Grand Fire (with Gouenji and Hiroto)

She is the daughter the prime minister. she seems to have a liking for Endou but she said that to her Endou is a soccer buddy.   Her hissatsu are:  [Season two] The Tower, Butterfly Dream (with Rika) and The Perfect Tower (with Tsunami and Kogure)  [Season three] The Tower V2

Originally a mid-fielder but became a goalkeeper due to his admiration for [Endou](https://anilist.co/character/16412/Endou-Mamoru). He is a great goalkeeper like Endou and can perform God Hand & Majin The Hand. He joined Inazuma Caravan to defeat Aliea Academy.
Self-proclaimed ace striker of the team, he had troubles with Goenji and later on with Fubuki, for that position.

Despite his height is a really shy person, sometimes even disappearing before a match, with the excuse of going to the bathroom. Most of the times [Endou](https://anilist.co/character/16412/Endou-Mamoru) has to help him overcome his fears.
The owner of Rairaiken Ramen shop. He turns out to be the goalkeeper of the legendary Inazuma Eleven. He later becomes the coach of Raimon and goes to Liocott with Inazuma Japan.

Kageyama Reiji is the coach for Teikoku Gakuen and Zeus. When he was young, he was a member of the Inazuma Eleven.

In season 2, he is the coach for Shin Teikoku Gakuen. Later in season 3, he uses an alias Mister K (ミスターK) and becomes the coach of Team K and Orpheus.

In Inazuma Eleven GO Galaxy, now known as Kuroiwa Ryuusei (黒岩くろいわ 流星りゅうせい), he is the coach for Inazuma Japan, Earth Eleven and Faram Dite.

In the alternate timeline of Inazuma Eleven Ares no Tenbin, Kageyama once again takes up the role of Teikoku Gakuen's coach. He later becomes the coach for Shadow of Orion in Inazuma Eleven Orion no Kokuin.

Fuyuka Ono is the daughter of Masataka Ono, adopted daughter of Coach Kudou and Endou's childhood friend. She is one of the managers of Inazuma Japan.  ~!She had an accident in the past which involved losing her parents life, because of it she got so depressed that she stopped eating and drinking which might have resulted in her death. She doesn't remember Mamoru because her childhood memories were erased so she could forget about her tragic past.!~
He is the Coach of Inazuma Japan and the foster father of Fuyuka. At first his training may come accross to the team as weird but in the end turn out to be effective.

He debuted as the captain of Aliea Academy's First rank team "Epsilon". In the FFI arc, he wanted to go against the world and persuaded Coach Hitomiko to form a team. His hissatsus are: Worm Hole, Drill Smasher, Gungrir, God Knows Remastered (in Neo Japan) Triangle Z Remastered, Illusion Ball and Dash Storm.

name.native: エドガー・バルチナス

node.description:
A forward and the captain of the England team, Knights of Queen.
His signature special technique is **Excalibur**.

He is a defender and is on the Inazuma Japan team and Raimon. Kogure is a short, cheeky troublemaker from Manyuuji Junior High in Kyoto.  His hissatsu include: [Season two] Senpuunijin and Perfect Tower (with Tsunami and Touko) The Earth (with rest of the Raimon team)

Rika is the captain of an all-girls soccer team in Osaka. She works at an Okonomiyaki restaurant with her mother and first appears when the Raimon Caravan comes to Osaka believing that Aliea Academy had a hidden base somewhere in a local amusement park. Rika, visiting the park at the time, comes across Ichinose and immediately falls head-over-heels for him, claiming him to be her "Darling" husband after he eats her "Lovey-Dovey-Dish" which was just a simple Okonomiyaki that she made.

[Mamoru Endou](https://anilist.co/character/16412/)'s Soccer-Superstar grandfather. Years ago, he was a member of the original "Inazuma Eleven" soccer team and then acted as the coach for the Raimon Junior High soccer club. 

~!He was killed in a car accident set up by his vengeful rival, [Reiji Kageyama](https://anilist.co/character/32156/).!~ ~!but upon inspection of the incident, turns out to have escaped from his life. With his daughter's family in danger of Kageyama's attacks, Endou leaves the country under the guise of being dead, but is discovered to be residing somewhere on Soccer Island where the Football Frontier International is being held.!~

Took the position of coach during the fight with Aliea Academy. Deep and shrewd, able to provide effective strategies in combat, but appears to find it a hassle to provide proper explanation.  Sister of Hiroto.

He used to live in America with Aki, but he didn't care for soccer because of an accident involving one of his best friends. He used to be in Teikoku until he came to Raimon to spy, and saw everyone working hard. He then decided to join the Raimon Soccer Club. With Endo, he feels that he can keep up with him, unlike his friend, Ichinose. He quits being a spy when Fuyukai, the coach and another spy from Teikoku, planned to blow up the bus they were using.
One of the starting Raimon Eleven in the anime. According to the DS games, he's known for his "half-done" "half-baked" attitude (a pun with his last name, Handa, which has the character for "half").
He is a mid-fielder in Raimon.

When Endou started to recruit members for his team Megane promised to join if Endou will recruit him at the end. He also said that he will join if Endou will make him the striker of Raimon Eleven. He is not a good player; he only helps when the team is low on members. He usually gives the name to Hissatsu techniques of other players.
A member of Tsunami's team in Omihara Junior High.

A forward and the captain of the Brazil team, The Kingdom. 
His signature special technique is **Strike Samba**.

Yuuka Gouenji the younger sister of Shuuya. She goes into a coma because she got hit by a car right before Shuuya's Final Frontier game.  He blames it on himself, that if he never played soccer, she'd never would've gotten hit and that's why Shuuya stops playing soccer. But Natsumi Raimon comforts Shuuya, then Shuuya starts playing soccer again.

name.native: デモーニオ・ストラーダ

node.description: Demonio used to play soccer in the suburbs of Italy along with the rest of Team K. Due to the boys' shared dream of playing in the nationals, Kageyama (then known as Mr. K) sought them out and offered them a deal. Join him and they would be able to play in the nationals. He was a huge fan of Fideo, until he joined Team K in which he saw himself as superior and looked down on the rest of Orpheus.

Junior High schooler from Okinawa, also part of the local soccer club. He takes care of five younger siblings, it's the main reason why he had to decline Endo's invitation to join Inazuma caravan. Hijikata is talented defense player.  Hiss hissatsu are: [Season two] Supershikifumi [Season three] Thunder Beast (with Fubuki), Blade Attack and Thunder Beast Remastered (with Fubuki)

Arata Shimozuru (下鶴改) is a forward and the ace striker of Mikage Sennou. In the game against Raimon he stopped Gouenji's Fire Tornado but at a cost. In the end he said they had a good time. He reapeared in the FFI arc, where plays for Neo Japan.  His hissatsu are: [Season one] Fire Tornado, Patriot shoot [Season three] Gungrir V2
The captain for Argentina's national team, The Empire.  His main hissatsu: [Season three] Iron Wall

One of Endo's first teammates, people usually don't notice him, because of his dark aura.  Later on Kageno is injured by Gemini Storm team and is left out of team for some time.  His hissatsu include: [Season one] Coil Turn [Season two] Dual Smash (with Sugimori, with the aid of Aliea meteorite)

Serious player from America. Mark was carrying his team's flag in the  _International Football Frontier_ opening ceremony. Also he's captain and one of the world's best players.  His Hissatsu are  [Season three] The Icarus, Unicorn Boost (with Dylan) and Gran Fenriri (with Ichinose and Dylan)
He's from Sengoku Igajima. He is a striker and incorporates ninja moves into his soccer.  His hissatsu include: [Season one] Earth Ball, After image
Atsuishi Shigeto is a member of Prominence and later on Chaos, then a midfielder of Neo Japan. In the game, he is a reserve goalkeeper of Neo Japan.
Suizenji Chiita is a forward of Nosei Junior High. He is very fast, and his character is based on the cheetah.

Midou Reika is a forward and ace striker for the Osaka Gals. She played with her team against Raimon, but Osaka Gals lost. During the match she was seen flirting with Kazemaru. She scored once using Butterfly Dream with Rika during the match.
A genius game maker from Japan, he is the real captain of the Orpheus.  His hissatsu shoot in   [Season three] Brave shot
He is the driver of the Inazuma Caravan in season two and accompanies the Inazuma Japan in season three. In season two, he also doubled as a refree in Raimon's matches against Aliea Academy.
Defender from Teikoku Gakuen.
He is a mid fielder in both Raimon and Inazuma Japan.

He is the ace striker of The Unicorn and an easy going person in general. He is a good friend of Mark as they are never seen without each other.  His hissatsu includes:  [Season three] Unicorn Boost (with Mark) and Gran Fenrir (with Mark and Ichinose)

Bjorn Kyle is the captain of Desert Lion. He is a defender. His team is from Qatar. He and his team lost against Inazuma Japan in their second match. He has teal hair that is a bit wavy covering his left eye, and has green eyes, with dark shadows under his eyes. His outfit has the design of the Qatar flag.He is shown to be caring for his team as he is determined to win against Inazuma Japan.  During the first half they haven't scored that much points against Inazuma Japan but during the second half they have the upper hand do to their high level of stamina under the heat of the sun which turned to their advantage, but they still lost to Inazuma Japan.
Koheita Fuuma is a player of Sengoku Igajima. His position is midfielder.
Oowashi Seiji is a midfielder for Nosei, the team that portrays animal moves.
Forward for Tenkuu no Shito

A forward of Australia's national team Big Waves which was the first team that Inazuma Japan faced in the Football Frontier Internationals Asian Perlimaneries.
He is a member of Nosei Junior High. His character is based on a chameleon.

First appearance in episode 105, she was blind because of Reiji Ageyama .He sent her to treatment at the hospital ,and when she was with Nakata and Luca, she want to meet him and thank him for what he made.
A defender for Hakuren.

node.description: Another of Endo's teammates, usually plays as defender.
Narukami is from Teikoku Academy and a member of it's soccer team. In the FFI arc, he along with Genda and Jimon join as members of Neo Japan.
He is one of the player of Teikoku and Neo Japan.  His hissatsu are: [Season one] Hyakuretsu shot, Death Zone (with Sakuma and Doumen) and Emperor Penguin No. 2 (with Kidou and Sakuma)

name.native: ショーン ピアース

node.description: He is one of the players of Teikoku Academy.

Nice Dolphin is the Captain of Big Waves and one of it's midfielders. He has golden yellow hair and teal eyes, he also is tall. He is nice and cares for his team deeply like most captains.   He appeared in the match Big Waves vs. Inazuma Japan. At first Inazuma Japan was having a hard time against Big Waves and their hissatsu tactic Box Lock Art Defense, but after everyone figured out how to break it, Inazuma Japan won.
Sugimori Takeshi is the captain and goalkeeper of Mikage Sennou and is usually seen with his teammate, Arata Shimozuru.

Aporo Hikarui is a defender for Zeus. His team played against Raimon in Football Frontier finals. In the end, they lost with 3-4. After that, he didn't appear anymore in the anime. His name is based on "Apollo", the Greek God of the sun and music.

He appeared as a defender of Zeus, and is also noted as one of the players who drank the Aqua of the Gods. Zeus played against Teikoku and won. His team played against Raimon in Football Frontier finals. In the end, they lost with 3-4. When the Football Frontier arc ended, he never reappeared. His name is based on Hephaestus, the Greek God of fire and technology.

node.description: He is the Captain of Fire Dragon and the main statergist.  His hissatsu is Naraku Otoshi. His tactics include Perfect Zone Press.
Ishidaira Hanzou is a defender for The Genesis and Neo Japan.

name.native: ジャンルカ ・ザナルディ

node.description: Team member of Italy's Orpheus in the FFI arc.

name.native: フィリップ・オーウェン

Kii Fumiko, alias Keeve is a defender from The Genesis. She is the number 3. She can uses gravitation and lightning like acceleration to pass the ball to Ulvida or Gran.
Prime Minister of Japan (on both separate worlds of Inazuma Eleven and Danball Senki) and Touko Zaizen's Father (on Inazuma Eleven).
Tsuuten Hikari is a reserve defender for Osaka Gals.
Jean Baker is the main goalkeeper for Big Waves.

It also displays how obedient the team is to Kageyama Reiji by following his orders. Though, after losing to Raimon he, along with his team, didn't use it again because he learns the importance of playing fair soccer. His team played the match against Teikoku and won. His team played against Raimon in Football Frontier finals. In the end they lost by 3-4 score. His name is based on "Ares", the Greek God of War.

ラファエレ・ジェネラーニ

node.description: A midfielder for Hakuren.  She has short maroon hair, brown eyes, and rosy cheeks. She wears a sort of a traditional hat tied with a white band.  (Source: Inazuma Eleven wiki)
Gary Links is a midfielder for Knights of Queen.

Satoshi Mutou, also known as Metron, is a forward for Epsilon and, later, a midfielder for Epsilon Kai. In the alternate timeline of Inazuma Eleven Ares no Tenbin, he is a midfielder for Eisei Gakuen.
Midfielder from Teikoku Gakuen.
Banjou Kazumichi is a defender from Teikoku Gakuen.
Dosu Koi is the goalkeeper for Osaka Gals.
Kushida Katsuyo is a defender for the Osaka Gals.
Shawn Beach is a defender for Big Waves.
Carmay Kola is a defender of Big Waves.
John Jones  is a forward for Big Waves.

Deio Geki is a defender for Zeus Junior High.   He has a big and a quite muscular body and wears the Zeus uniform. His hair is colored light and grayish brown.   Just like most members of the team, he depends on the Aqua of Gods that was given to them by Kageyama. It also displays how obedient they are to Kageyama Reiji by following his orders. Though, after losing to Raimon he, along with his team, doesn't use it again because he learns the importance of playing fair soccer.   (Source: Inazuma Eleven Wiki)

Kenzaki Ryuuichi is a a character in the second season of Inazuma Eleven. He helped Kira Seijirou with the Aliea project. He was also the coach of Dark Emperors.   He is a person that does not care to what happens to other people, and is selfish and only cares for his own desires.He is a big liar.   (Source: Inazuma Eleven Wiki)

Honba is big, tall and slightly fat. His body suits his position as a defender. He also wears a blue headband.   He first appears in Episode 56 with Chaos. He used Ignite Steal against Raimon, however the match was interrupted by Gran.
Posei is the goalkeeper for Zeus. His name is based off Poseidon.   (Source: Inazuma Eleven Wiki)
Biruda Kouichi is a forward of Inazuma Eleven.
The goalkeeper for Hakuren.

He is a defender for Hakuren.  Yukino has a big body, fair skin tone, eyes always closed, and blushed cheeks.He wears a great, rosy hood around that covers the diameter of his head. He tends to sneeze a lot.  (Source: Inazuma Eleven wiki)
The coach of Occult team.
